reference_sql:
SELECT category_name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN quarter(order_date) = 1 THEN units ELSE 0 END) AS q1_units,
  SUM(CASE WHEN quarter(order_date) = 2 THEN units ELSE 0 END) AS q2_units,
  SUM(CASE WHEN quarter(order_date) = 3 THEN units ELSE 0 END) AS q3_units,
  SUM(CASE WHEN quarter(order_date) = 4 THEN units ELSE 0 END) AS q4_units
FROM sales
WHERE parent_category = 'Audio'
  AND order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY category_name
alternatives:
SELECT category_name, COALESCE(q1, 0) AS q1_units, COALESCE(q2, 0) AS q2_units, COALESCE(q3, 0) AS q3_units, COALESCE(q4, 0) AS q4_units
FROM (
  -- one row per Audio order line of 2025
  SELECT category_name, quarter(order_date) AS qtr, units
  FROM sales
  WHERE parent_category = 'Audio'
    AND order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
) AS s
PIVOT (SUM(units) FOR qtr IN (1 AS q1, 2 AS q2, 3 AS q3, 4 AS q4) GROUP BY category_name)

SELECT category_name,
  COALESCE(SUM(units) FILTER (WHERE quarter(order_date) = 1), 0) AS q1_units,
  COALESCE(SUM(units) FILTER (WHERE quarter(order_date) = 2), 0) AS q2_units,
  COALESCE(SUM(units) FILTER (WHERE quarter(order_date) = 3), 0) AS q3_units,
  COALESCE(SUM(units) FILTER (WHERE quarter(order_date) = 4), 0) AS q4_units
FROM sales
WHERE parent_category = 'Audio'
  AND order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY category_name
